messages:
nina: Quick thought — can we prototype a small dashboard that shows 'token garden' tiles: per-model marginal cost, recent cache-savings, and routing impact per-route?
kevin: +1. Need something lightweight for the Console home. :seedling:
samir: What does "marginal cost" mean here? per-token after caching and batching?
nina: yeah, per-invocation effective cost after applying cache credits and batching amortization. Not the invoice, just a quick signal for devs.
emma: Love that. We should show a small timeseries + last-invocation sample. Avoid heavy joins in the UI query.
ashley: tiny nit: routing impact is tricky — when a route falls back to cheaper model we should show the delta and which fallback triggered.
nina: agreed. UX idea: tile shows model, avg cost/token, cache saved tokens, fallback rate. Click to expand to sample traces.
kevin: backend ask: we need a compact pre-agg keyed by (route, model, minute_bucket) including fields: tokens_total, tokens_from_cache, invocations, fallback_count. That can be rolled up easily.
samir: I sketched a SQL for the pre-agg, simple materialized view:```sql
SELECT route_id, model_sku, date_trunc('minute', ts) AS minute, 
 SUM(tokens) AS tokens_total, SUM(tokens_cached) AS tokens_from_cache, 
 COUNT(1) AS invocations, SUM(is_fallback::int) AS fallback_count
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
emma: That looks fine. We need to be careful with tokens_cached definition — our edge sometimes double-counts when prefix cache hits and KV cache both apply. Add a dedupe flag or use first-hit priority.
kevin: Good call. Add `cache_source_priority` in the event schema, store the winner so the pre-agg uses only winner==true.
ashley: How about quotas? The frontend team wants per-route quota burn estimate on the same tile so PMs can see if a new model rollout will blow budgets.
nina: We can show a projected 24h burn at current rates and a conservative 95th percentile estimate. Keep the math in the backend service, expose just numbers.
samir: One more ops concern — sampling. We can't run full resolution for all tenants. Proposal: full resolution for top 100 tenants by spend, 1% sampling for others, and extrapolate.
emma: Works. Add a "confidence" indicator on the tile so users understand sampling. :bar_chart:
kevin: For rollout UX: when doing canary routing, the tile should expose canary vs baseline side-by-side and a tiny link to start a cost-aware rollback.
nina: Love the rollback link idea. devex-bot can suggest the rollback command if the delta > 2x baseline.
devex-bot: NOTE: automated suggestion requires feature-flag `econ-ops-suggestions`. Triggering check will call /internal/rollback-suggest. :robot_face:
ashley: Who owns the API for the pre-agg? If infra owns it, we'll need an SLA on freshness (<= 2m) and an endpoint that supports route+model filters.
kevin: Infra will own it. SLA ok, but we need enough compute budget. I'll add it to next sprint and list the dimensions.
nina: Next steps: kevin/infra to prototype MV + API, samir to add cache winner flag to events, emma/UX to mock tiles (confidence + canary diff). I'll post a short spec tomorrow.
emma: I'll mock a compact 320px tile with color-coded confidence and a hover with sample traces.
samir: I'll add the `cache_winner` change and a migration plan for backfill. Should be non-blocking.
kevin: I'll stub an API that returns top-N models per route with pre-agg values and the 24h projection.
nina: Great. Thanks all. If anyone sees a major gap call it out here. :raised_hands:
